description: Re-sign a COMPLETE render's output URL. A render's presigned MP4 link lasts ~7 days, so wait_job / getRender on an old render hands back a link that 403s; this mints a fresh one for the same file and returns { outputUrl, outputExpiresAt }. Needs projectId + renderId (from create_render). 422 render_not_complete while the render is still running or failed — wait_job for it first. Requires renders:write (the row's stored URL is updated).

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: refresh_render_url
title: Refresh Render Url
